General input, analysis and conclusion 4.1 There is no valid reason to change QoS Regulations (a) Input of Stakeholders (i) Few service providers submitted that nowhere in the consultation paper any valid justification has been provided for change in the prevailing Regulations. We are also unable to find any statistics of complaints that can indicate that there is any gap in QoS received and QoS reported. (ii) It is also submitted that the technological evolution should have nothing to do with QoS reporting, especially with reducing technology life cycles.
